name: popsicle
headline: Percolate Content Marketing Process: Campaign
short_description: This documentation lays out Percolate's approach to content marketing. This is the process the marketing department follows to move work from idea through execution, and can be used as a workflow reference for campaign management, content marketing / brand editorial, or other business process design.
author: chrisbolman

sections.overview:
Percolate's Content Marketing Process is a documented workflow system that guides marketing teams through nine distinct phases, from initial brief through final execution. It provides clear accountability structures, role definitions, and decision frameworks to streamline campaign management and content development. The system segments work by customer journey stage, business objective, target audience, and geography to prioritize content volume and targets. Teams use responsibility matrices, brief templates, and proposal structures to minimize delays and ensure consistent, efficient delivery. This framework works for integrated teams of 10-20 members and can be adapted for larger or smaller organizations.
Campaign management workflow setup and team accountability
Content marketing process documentation and optimization
Brand editorial workflow and publishing schedule management
Business process design for marketing departments
